## Purpose

What problem does this solve?

## Behavior

What changes for users or contributors? Include authorization and error paths.

## Validation

Commands/results and meaningful coverage. Identify untested paths. For UI changes include screenshots and accessibility checks.

## Deployment and migration impact

Configuration/secret names (never values), schema compatibility, ordering, release/rollback considerations. State if none.

## Sensitive-change review

- [ ] Authentication, authorization, membership, or data privacy impact considered.
- [ ] Workflow trust boundaries, secrets, and dependency changes considered.
- [ ] AI findings checked against source and reviewed SHA; unavailable/incomplete reviews identified.
